primary.title: PhonePe to charge ₹100 quarterly fee on wallets inactive for a year: Here's how users can avoid it
primary.summary: PhonePe has introduced a ₹100 quarterly inactivity fee for wallets not used in 365 days. Users must complete a transaction to avoid charges. Details here.
